name: 研究对象与任务覆盖
description: UFEval targets four evaluation tasks, NLG, IU, IG, and ITIG, across 28 sub-tasks. The six input/output modality combinations are stated in the method; the public/generated composition is visualized in Figure 2.

name: FRABench 数据来源与规模
description: The dataset combines 29.3K response pairs from public datasets and 30.1K generated pairs, totaling 60.4K pairwise samples and 325K fine-grained labels. Generated responses come from varied MLLMs; Appendix B.1 lists them.

name: aspect taxonomy
description: A manually organized hierarchy contains 112 aspects. The root is overall; UAs capture output-quality and modality-linked criteria, while TAs capture task completion. The authors reuse ten literature trees, then insert unmatched aspects by bidirectional name/definition matching or independent roots.

name: pairwise labels and prompt control
description: Each pair receives an average of 8 UAs and 3 TAs. Human labels reuse three-aspect ImageRewardDB annotations with GPT-4o feedback; remaining labels are GPT-4o-generated. For UA judging GPT-4o sees only the responses, excluding the query to reduce correctness contamination. Surplus majority labels are position-reversed and re-annotated.

name: 数据划分
description: Training plus FRA-ID covers 18 randomly selected sub-tasks, 22 UAs, and 35 TAs; FRA-OOD holds out 10 sub-tasks, with 28 seen UAs and 27 unseen TAs. Sizes are 255.4K, 45.2K, and 24.4K samples. FRA-ID-H and FRA-OOD-H retain 6.9K and 6.0K human evaluation samples.

name: human annotation design
description: Three graduate/master-level annotators score each aspect concurrently on a five-point Likert scale; TA inapplicability is encoded as -1. Human annotation UI and agreement analyses are in Appendix E.

name: UFEval training
description: UFEval-7B fine-tunes Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct with SFT. Appendix C specifies Llama-Factory, 64 NVIDIA A100 GPUs, per-GPU one sample, gradient accumulation 2, total batch 128, CPU optimizer offload, three epochs, learning rate 1e-5, 1% warmup, cosine decay, and cross-entropy on judgments plus justifications.

name: benchmark suite

name: metric and aggregation

name: data leakage control

name: 随机种子与完整超参数

description: 16 sources are listed, each with at least 50B tokens. Single-source runs hold 3B and 30B fixed.

name: Two-stage MLLM adaptation
description: Frozen vision encoder plus MLP projector for visual alignment, followed by supervised fine-tuning over vision-language and language-only instructions.

name: Default encoder and optimization
description: MetaCLIP-B/16 and 576 visual tokens; AdamW, cosine schedule, linear warm-up, one epoch, fixed seed 42 and stable loading order.

name: Language evaluation
description: Average ppl over Wikitext/LAMBADA and unweighted average accuracy over PIQA, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, ARC, Copa, SciQA, OpenbookQA and BoolQA.

name: MLLM evaluation categories
description: 16 public benchmarks are grouped into General, Knowledge, OCR & Chart VQA and Vision-Centric; category and overall averages are reported.

name: Robust free-form answer parsing
description: Prioritized parser checks explicit option letters, exact option text, then substring matches, choosing the longest option text when ambiguous.

name: Scale experiment
description: Five model sizes and eight web-crawl data volumes identify non-uniform scaling across VQA categories.

name: Single-source attribution
description: Sixteen 3B models each train on one source for 30B tokens, enabling source-wise downstream comparison.

name: Fine-grained ratio intervention
description: Each reasoning/visual category is assigned 0%, 25%, 50%, 75% or 100%, with remaining data sampled proportionally from the 300B pool and total 30B held constant.

name: Recipe derivation
description: A 24-blend vision grid search targets 60% reasoning/15% visual; ten language experiments define mix0; mix0→mix10 interpolation chooses mix6.

name: Structure diagnostic
description: Spearman correlations are computed across 105 3B models over four VQA categories to identify coupled skill clusters.

name: Encoder universality
description: MetaCLIP-B/16 is joined by DINOv2-G and MAE-H while reasoning proportion varies, testing modality-agnostic transfer.

name: Instruction-data removal
description: Cambrian-7M is classified into 1.8M perception, 0.6M reasoning and 2.6M other; perception/reasoning portions are removed 100%→50%→0% with other fixed.

name: 1T scale-up validation
description: Two 7B models train on 1T tokens, comparing Language-Favorable mix0 with Balanced mix6.

name: MLE-Bench hypothesis test
description: 1,861 images are split into 732 small, 698 medium and 431 large-object questions; 16 single-source models and external MLLMs are evaluated.

name: Reasoning-trace judge
description: Knowledge/Vision-Centric VQA is answered with explanations and scored by a separate 32B LLM for Logical Soundness and Reasoning Depth.

name: Alignment hypothesis test
description: WIT image-caption kernels are compared by mNN with k=20 and averaged against ViT-Large, DINOv2-Giant and CLIP-Huge.

name: Controls and missing design facts
